description: This file contains routines and classes for parsing documentation comment blocks and building structured content objects, including classes for handling code snippets, paragraphs, fields, markup, chapters, sections, and blocks within a documentation processing system.

classes.name: DocCode
classes.description: Stores source code lines for documentation, capable of dumping formatted code.

classes.name: DocPara
classes.description: Stores normal text paragraphs for documentation, capable of formatting and dumping text.

classes.name: DocField
classes.description: Stores a list of DocPara or DocCode objects, representing fields in documentation comments.

classes.name: DocMarkup
classes.description: Represents a markup section in documentation, containing fields and associated content.

classes.name: DocChapter
classes.description: Represents a chapter in documentation, containing sections.

classes.name: DocSection
classes.description: Represents a section in documentation, containing blocks and metadata.

classes.name: ContentProcessor
classes.description: Processes content blocks, manages sections, chapters, and markup parsing for documentation.

classes.name: DocBlock
classes.description: Represents a documentation block, parsing markup and source code from source files.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes objects for code, paragraph, field, markup, chapter, section, content processing, or block parsing.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs formatted content for code, paragraph, or markup objects.

methods.name: dump_lines
methods.description: Returns lines of formatted content for code, paragraph, or markup objects.

methods.name: set_section
methods.description: Sets the current documentation section in the content processor.

methods.name: add_chapter
methods.description: Adds a chapter to the documentation structure.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the content processor state for a new block.

methods.name: add_markup
methods.description: Adds a new markup section to the content processor.

methods.name: process_content
methods.description: Processes block content into markup objects.

methods.name: parse_sources
methods.description: Parses source blocks for documentation comment blocks.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes processing of sections and chapters, establishing relationships.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a documentation block, parsing markup and source code.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Returns the location of the source block.

methods.name: get_markup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific markup section by tag.

methods.name: get_markup_words
methods.description: Retrieves words from a markup section.

methods.name: get_markup_words_all
methods.description: Retrieves all words from a markup section, including empty lines.

methods.name: get_markup_text
methods.description: Joins and returns text from a markup section.

methods.name: get_markup_items
methods.description: Retrieves items from a markup section.
